subject.name: Plasterers and stucco masons
subject.summary: Plasterers and stucco masons clean and protect construction surfaces, apply plaster or decorative stucco to walls, ceilings, and partitions with trowels, brushes, or spray equipment, and inspect the finish as the project requires. Working at height and respirable silica dust risks are controlled by on-site safety rules; paper exercises do not constitute construction qualification.
